concepts.title: Weather Question: How is the weather?
concepts.explanation: Use '今天天气怎么样？' to ask about today's weather.
concepts.note: 怎么样 (zěnme yàng) means 'how is it?'.

concepts.title: Describing Weather with Adjectives
concepts.explanation: Use '很 + adjective' to describe weather conditions.
concepts.note: 很 (hěn) is often required before adjectives and doesn’t always mean 'very'.

concepts.title: Weather Type with 是
concepts.explanation: Use '是 + weather type noun' for conditions like sunny or cloudy.
concepts.note: Use 是 only with nouns like 晴天 (sunny day), not adjectives like 热.

concepts.title: Using 下 for Rain, Snow, Hail
concepts.explanation: Use '下' to describe precipitation like rain, snow, or hail.
concepts.note: 下 literally means 'to fall'. Used with weather like rain (雨), snow (雪), hail (冰雹).

concepts.title: Talking About Wind
concepts.explanation: Use '刮风' to say it is windy.
concepts.note: 刮风 is a fixed verb phrase meaning 'wind is blowing'.

concepts.title: Time + Weather Structure
concepts.explanation: Time expressions come before the weather description.
concepts.note: Always place time before the adjective or verb.

concepts.title: Future Weather
concepts.explanation: Use time words like 明天 (tomorrow) to talk about future weather.
concepts.note: Chinese often uses time words instead of future tense markers.
